runtime_lock_layers.ratified_protocol_lock: these exact algorithms, repository revisions, engines, ceilings, schemas, compiler views, failure semantics, and review boundaries
runtime_lock_layers.pre_dev_executable_lock: CPU-produced actual snapshot, tokenizer, chat-template, software, container, binary, numerical-policy, and implementation-source hashes plus tokenizer/compiler/collator golden fixtures that do not depend on heldout M1; reviewed and sealed before DEV
runtime_lock_layers.realized_lora_lock: after both heldout M1_OWN manifests seal and before either fit, materialize and seal every realized per-life compiler vector, candidate roster, collation vector, epoch permutation, batch membership vector, evaluated optimizer-step count, and associated hash; bind these artifacts into the HELDOUT_TO_LORA review and authority
runtime_lock_layers.post_dev_change: a byte already sealed before DEV may not change; the only permitted later additions are protocol-prescribed realized heldout and LoRA artifacts whose inputs did not exist before DEV, and each must seal at its prescribed boundary without selecting a new semantic or numerical rule; any changed sealed byte requires a newly ratified protocol and new CPU-to-DEV review

software: container digest or immutable environment manifest
required_executable_lock.file_resolution: all regular snapshot files sorted by UTF-8 path bytes; reject symlinks, missing files, post-lock downloads, fallback snapshots, local revision suffixes, or hash drift

controller_generation.seed: the operation contract profile-and-slot SHA-256 derivation; life, latent bit, branch result, donor identity, and answer are never seed material
controller_generation.output_limit_reached: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE; consumes the dispatched opportunity; no retry

required: no active sequence before and after
provider_receipt.pre_dispatch_lock_or_authority_mismatch: NON_DISPATCH_PRECONDITION/PRE_DISPATCH_INVALID_PRECONDITION for a bad lock or NON_DISPATCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED/STAGE_NOT_AUTHORIZED for missing authority under opportunity_ledger.schema.json; no provider attempt

compiler_binding.input: one life's already sealed M1_OWN canonical accepted rows validating memory_row.schema.json
compiler_binding.view_instances_per_row: one FIELD_COMPLETION_FORWARD, one FIELD_COMPLETION_REVERSE, one DECLARATIVE_RECOGNITION, and one QUESTION_RECOGNITION for every legal missing index of that kind
compiler_binding.templates: the four exact cue/completion byte-construction families and every required missing-index instance in compiler_views.json; no natural-language alternate
compiler_binding.golden_vectors: generic tokenizer/compiler fixtures seal in the pre-DEV executable lock; every required vector field for every realized M1_OWN row/view/missing-index instance is materialized under the same locked tokenizer after M1_OWN seals and is reviewed and sealed in the realized LoRA lock before either fit
compiler_binding.mismatch: a generic fixture mismatch is INVALID_PRECONDITION before DEV; a realized-row mismatch is INVALID_PRECONDITION before either fit; no fallback, normalization, alternate template, or post-seal regeneration

memory_tokenization.input_bytes: compiler cue UTF-8 bytes concatenated with compiler completion UTF-8 bytes
memory_tokenization.eos: append exactly one resolved memory-base eos_token_id after the completion LF; reject a completion whose ordinary encoding already ends in eos_token_id
memory_tokenization.normalization: none outside the locked tokenizer implementation
memory_tokenization.boundary_acceptance: encode(cue)||encode(completion) must equal encode(cue||completion); otherwise INVALID_PRECONDITION
memory_tokenization.round_trip_acceptance: decode(encode(cue||completion), skip_special_tokens=false) must reproduce the exact UTF-8 bytes

lora_training.fits: exactly one independent fit for each of the two scored lives, conditional on reviewed T pass; absent an infrastructure invalidity, both fits complete before either fidelity result is allowed to terminate the stage
lora_training.base_reload: reload the pristine memory-base snapshot in a fresh process for each fit and verify its root hash before attaching PEFT

dtype_and_autocast.adapter_parameter_storage_and_compute: bfloat16 from construction through save and inference
dtype_and_autocast.optimizer_state_dtype: the locked torch.optim.AdamW implementation's state dtype for bfloat16 parameters; materialize and seal it in a pre-fit generic optimizer fixture
dtype_and_autocast.logits_for_loss: cast the complete causal-LM logits tensor to float32 exactly once immediately before shifted cross entropy
dtype_and_autocast.dtype_mismatch: INVALID_PRECONDITION before a fit if discoverable from fixtures, otherwise INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE; no implicit PEFT upcast or mixed-precision fallback

lora_training.precision: explicit bfloat16 storage and compute under dtype_and_autocast; no autocast or loss scaling
lora_training.checkpoint_selection: final state after the last optimizer step of epoch 4 only
lora_training.trainable_parameters: freeze every base parameter; sort every and only requires_grad PEFT adapter parameter by fully qualified parameter-name ASCII bytes; one AdamW parameter group contains tensors in that exact order; apply the configured weight decay to the entire group
lora_training.model_mode: model.train() for fitting; no evaluation interleaving or checkpoint validation
lora_training.loss: standard one-token causal shift; compute float32 cross entropy with reduction=mean over every shifted non--100 label in the whole batch (unmasked cue tokens after sequence position 0, completion tokens, and appended EOS); sequence position 0 is context only; no prompt masking or label smoothing
lora_training.zero_grad: optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=true) immediately before every batch forward
update_order_per_batch: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ over trainable parameters in the same fully-qualified-name-sorted order with max_norm=1.0,norm_type=2.0,error_if_nonfinite=true,foreach=false
lora_training.failure: overflow, NaN, nonfinite loss or gradient, runtime drift, truncation, incomplete save, reused state, cross-life examples, or stacked adapter is INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE without retry
lora_training.output: safetensors adapter weights plus adapter config, exact example manifest, epoch permutations, batch manifest, optimizer-step manifest, RNG receipts, and fit manifest; adapter ID hashes every emitted leaf except the manifest containing that ID

example_multiplicity_and_order.touch_semantics: one exposure is one full cue||completion||EOS sequence presentation; the unmasked cue tokens after position zero, completion, and EOS all contribute token-level loss, so exposure counts do not assert answer-only supervision or equal optimizer mass across variable-length examples
example_multiplicity_and_order.example_identity: semantic_hash, view_id, missing_index, repetition_index where repetition_index starts at 0 independently for each row/view/missing-index instance
example_multiplicity_and_order.base_order: ascending sequence token count, then semantic_hash ASCII bytes, then compiler_views.views_in_order ordinal, then missing_index ascending, then repetition_index
example_multiplicity_and_order.epoch_permutation: for epoch 0 through 3, call one permutation(base_example_count) from the same continuously advanced NumPy Generator(PCG64(0)); do not reseed between epochs
example_multiplicity_and_order.batching: slice each epoch permutation consecutively into batches of 32; keep the final incomplete batch; never bucket, rebalance, pad examples, or carry examples across epochs
example_multiplicity_and_order.exact_step_binding: for each life, seal every per-kind row count, N, every epoch permutation, every batch membership vector, and the evaluated total optimizer-step integer in the realized LoRA lock before either fit; any disagreement with the formula is INVALID_PRECONDITION

collation.batch_width: maximum unpadded sequence length in that batch
collation.input_ids: unmodified sequence then pad_token_id through batch_width
collation.attention_mask: 1 for every unpadded token including appended EOS, then 0 for padding
collation.labels: copy input_ids at unpadded positions including cue, completion, and appended EOS; use -100 at padding positions
collation.position_ids: not passed explicitly; locked model implementation derives them from attention_mask
collation.golden_collation_vectors: generic pre-DEV fixtures cover one full batch and one incomplete batch; after M1_OWN seals, realized per-life vectors cover every actual batch and seal input_ids, attention_mask, labels, tensor shapes, dtypes, and sha256 of canonical little-endian tensor bytes in the realized LoRA lock before either fit

process_start_order: construct NumPy Generator(PCG64(0)) for epoch permutations only
rng_and_determinism.fit_seed_reuse: each fresh per-life process begins from the identical seed-0 state; no RNG state is inherited between lives
rng_and_determinism.rng_receipts: seal Python, NumPy bit-generator, torch CPU, and every CUDA RNG-state hash immediately before adapter construction, before each epoch, and after the final optimizer step

candidate_registry_and_recognition.seal_time: after both M1_OWN semantic-row manifests and resolved tokenizer vectors, before final-goal reveal or either fit
candidate_registry_and_recognition.cue: exact registry-view and missing-index cue bytes from compiler_views.json; online reads register QUESTION_RECOGNITION at every schema-legal missing index; fidelity uses its separately specified four family cases per row
candidate_registry_and_recognition.candidate_disclosure: the 7B receives a shared host-enumerated union roster built from both semantic-only backends, including the exact answer completion among at most sixteen candidates when registered; the same roster is used across own/twin and contains no backend-membership or donor-identity label, and no roster byte is exposed to the 32B thinker
candidate_registry_and_recognition.candidate_completion: exact candidate completion_utf8_hex plus completion_token_ids_including_eos sealed in the matching registry roster; the token vector must equal encode(completion bytes,add_special_tokens=false) followed by exactly one EOS, and no runtime token is appended beyond that sealed vector
candidate_registry_and_recognition.prompt_tokenization: tokenize cue once with add_special_tokens=false and reuse the identical cue token IDs for every candidate; do not reuse a KV cache or mutable prompt state
candidate_registry_and_recognition.pre_score_manifest_resolution: using only the mounted semantic-only backend, apply the text reader's exact partial-query match before mounting or scoring: zero distinct values returns NOT_FOUND, two or more returns CONFLICT, and exactly one proceeds to candidate recognition
candidate_registry_and_recognition.candidate_evaluation_order_and_batching: for a unique-value query, use an exclusive engine with no other active sequence and evaluate candidates sequentially in the sealed registry candidates-array order, one isolated cue||candidate forward sequence at a time, with no cross-candidate batching, padding, prefix cache, KV reuse, generation, sampling, or candidate-order rewrite; the enclosing cue-roster operation is one atomic recognition cycle
candidate_registry_and_recognition.logit_extraction: for each candidate request, obtain the locked model's complete vocabulary logits at exactly the causal positions predicting every completion token including EOS; cast each complete vocabulary-logit vector from the locked bfloat16 inference output to float32, apply one float32 log_softmax over the full vocabulary, select the registered token log probability, append in token order, then sum left-to-right in float64 and divide once in float64 by completion-token count
candidate_registry_and_recognition.scoring: the mean from logit_extraction is the sole candidate score; model.eval(), LoRA dropout disabled, no autocast, and no sampling RNG consumption
candidate_registry_and_recognition.nonfinite_score: any nonfinite source logit, log_softmax value, token log probability, float64 sum, or mean is INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE/LORA_RUNTIME_FAILURE; no candidate winner and no retry
candidate_registry_and_recognition.tie: all candidates within absolute 1e-7 of the maximum are tied; a tie of two or more returns CONFLICT
candidate_registry_and_recognition.mapping: apply memory_transport_contract.json candidate_winner_mapping against only the mounted backend manifest
candidate_registry_and_recognition.thinker_projection: return only JCS bytes validating read_result.schema.json
candidate_registry_and_recognition.mount_cycle: after a unique-value pre-score resolution, mount the exact fit-receipt adapter, score one atomic cue roster, map one result, record the complete scoring and mount receipt, unmount, and verify clean base before the next 32B continuation; NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT pre-score results require no adapter mount

fidelity_gate.selection_per_life: take up to the first eight eligible DREAMED rows by semantic_hash ASCII bytes, then eligible WITNESSED rows by semantic_hash ASCII bytes until exactly twelve total; fewer than twelve total is INVALID_PRECONDITION
fidelity_gate.training_set_resubstitution_identity: The twelve selected rows are members of that life's M1_OWN training corpus. Each of the four cases per selected row uses one of the same four view families used in training and the same row semantics; those row/view/missing-index instances were repeatedly exposed according to example_multiplicity_and_order. Thus all 48 cases are training-derived selected-cue resubstitution checks, not unseen or held-out examples.
fidelity_gate.expected: the unique source-row completion and semantic_hash under that life's own backend manifest
fidelity_gate.correct: unique candidate winner maps through the registry to a ROW result with the expected semantic_hash; NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, wrong value, or wrong hash is incorrect
fidelity_gate.gate_evaluation_order: absent an infrastructure invalidity, complete and seal both independent fits and all 48 fidelity cases for each life before evaluating either scientific fidelity threshold; a below-threshold first life never cancels the second fit or its cases
fidelity_gate.gate: after both completed case sets seal, both independently must pass before any L-OWN or L-TWIN 32B request; otherwise VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED and every registered L thinker opportunity is an exact zero-attempt NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FIDELITY_FAILURE/NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED row under opportunity_ledger.schema.json
fidelity_gate.cases_and_order: presealed before final-goal reveal; row selection order then compiler_views.views_in_order

per_life_isolation.adapter_binding: one adapter hash binds one scored life, one M1_OWN manifest hash, one compiler-vector manifest hash, one candidate-registry hash, one fit manifest, and one pristine base root
per_life_isolation.inference_mount: one adapter for one host-side atomic read only
per_life_isolation.cross_life_mounts: allowed only for registered L-TWIN reads; a mount never directly changes an already sealed 32B request, while its returned read result and causally downstream 32B requests may differ
per_life_isolation.own_twin_request_equivalence: L-OWN and L-TWIN for one recipient start from byte-identical initial 32B state, state-token vocabulary, prompt bytes, token IDs, seed, generation config, and clean controller runtime; operation-locally, equal complete pre-read states and equal emitted queries differ only in the mounted 7B adapter/backend binding; differing read results and every causally downstream state, scratch, query, request, terminal, and trace byte are authorized descendants of the intervention
per_life_isolation.unmount_verification: after every read, active-adapter set is empty and pristine base parameter/storage hashes match the executable-lock verification set

artifact_identity.manifest_rule: sorted UTF-8 leaf path, byte count, and sha256 entries excluding the manifest itself
artifact_identity.adapter_receipt_rule: mounted adapter hash must equal the completed fit output hash and the registered life binding
artifact_identity.request_receipt_rule: runtime configuration, executable lock, semantic reader manifest, candidate registry, and adapter binding are independently hashed to avoid circularity
artifact_identity.changed_byte_rule: any changed source row, view byte, token ID, roster, example order, batch, RNG setting, optimizer step, adapter file, or mount receipt invalidates downstream authority

claim_boundary.maximum: Exactly two per-life adapters may be described only as reaching the registered immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition threshold on selected cues and supporting their registered one-pair own/donor decision paths when the complete gate passes.
required_disclosures: twelve selected M1_OWN training rows per life and one selected cue from each row's four trained view families
repeated training exposure of the evaluated row/view semantics: 24 presentations per concept row/view/missing-index instance or 96 per relation instance over four epochs
host pre-resolution of zero, one, or multiple semantic values
one shared host-enumerated two-backend answer-bearing roster
the selected 48 cues and separate 44/48 threshold for each life
public actions were environment-generated rather than model-selected
claim_boundary.own_donor_boundary: The fidelity metric is in-sample resubstitution over each adapter's own selected training-derived cues. L-OWN and L-TWIN are separately the only registered decision paths: the recipient's own adapter/backend or the donor adapter/backend. Do not describe the donor path as unseen generalization; it is an intervention over separately trained life-specific adapters and manifests.

ceilings.atomic_recognition_cycle_formula: F scored fidelity cycles plus Q scored online unique-value query cycles where 0<=F<=96 and 0<=Q<=48; all 96 fidelity cases are evaluated, but pre-score NOT_FOUND or CONFLICT cases do not mount or consume a recognition cycle
